# `logout.aug`

<a id="symbol-logout"></a>
## `logout` · [source](logout.aug#L10)

POST logout checks the origin and session-bound CSRF value, then removes the live registry entry before clearing the cookie. The caller supplies `input` as [`LogoutForm`](contracts.aug.md#symbol-LogoutForm) from HTTP form, `token` as `optional string` from HTTP cookie `aug_session` (omitted means null), and `origin` as `optional string` from HTTP header (omitted means null). Dependency injection supplies `crypto` as [`Crypto`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/crypto/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Crypto), `clock` as [`Clock`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/time/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Clock), `keys` as [`SigningKeys`](../common/keys.aug.md#symbol-SigningKeys), and `sessions` as [`ExpiringStore<SessionClaims>`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/memory/store.aug.md#symbol-ExpiringStore).

The result is `HttpResponse<Html>`. It can use [`crypto.publicRsa`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/crypto/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Crypto.publicRsa), [`crypto.decodeBase64url`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/crypto/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Crypto.decodeBase64url), [`crypto.verifyRsa`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/crypto/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Crypto.verifyRsa), [`crypto.equal`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/crypto/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Crypto.equal), [`clock.now`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/time/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Clock.now), [`keys.session`](../common/keys.aug.md#symbol-SigningKeys.session), [`sessions.get`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/memory/store.aug.md#symbol-ExpiringStore.get), and [`sessions.take`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/memory/store.aug.md#symbol-ExpiringStore.take). It can fail with `SessionError`, `KeyError`, `TimeError`, `CryptoError`, and `HttpError`. This handles `POST` requests at `/logout`. Use status 200 when the handler returns a body; a returned HttpResponse can set its own status. An unhandled request failure returns status 500 and cancels its request tasks. For declared failures, [`SessionError`](contracts.aug.md#symbol-SessionError) returns status 403.

It sets `config` to the value from [`settings`](../common/settings.aug.md#symbol-settings). If `origin` does not equal `config.baseUrl`, it fails with a new [`SessionError`](contracts.aug.md#symbol-SessionError). It sets `session` to the value from [`authenticate`](session.aug.md#symbol-authenticate) (`token`) using `crypto`, `clock`, `keys`, `sessions`. If not (the value from [`Crypto.equal`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/crypto/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Crypto.equal) on `crypto` (`left` set to the UTF-8 bytes of `input.csrf` and `right` set to the UTF-8 bytes of `session.csrf`)), it fails with a new [`SessionError`](contracts.aug.md#symbol-SessionError). It calls [`ExpiringStore.take`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/memory/store.aug.md#symbol-ExpiringStore.take) on `sessions` (`key` set to `session.jti` and `now` set to the value from [`Clock.now`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/time/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Clock.now) on `clock`).

It sets `headers` to the value from [`withCookie`](../common/headers.aug.md#symbol-withCookie) (`headers` set to the value from `with` on the value from [`securityHeaders`](../common/headers.aug.md#symbol-securityHeaders) (`name` set to `"location"` and `value` set to `"/"`), `name` set to `"aug_session"`, `value` set to `""`, `path` set to `"/"`, `maxAge` set to `0`, and `secure` set to `config.secureCookies`). It returns a new `HttpResponse` (`body` set to the HTML element `p` containing `Signed out.` (server-rendered; text escaped), `status` set to `303`, and `headers`).
